page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Four small chronological headings in italic lines (§. 14, §. 15, §. 16 and the lines of Herodis fractions) stand within the text. No marginal notes in the left or right margin; the right edge shows only show-through and the neighbouring page. Printed page number 232 and running head "ANNALES GESTORUM" at the top. Catchword "He-" at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Herodes, ob hoc crimen ab Alexandrâ apud Cleopatram delatus, & per eam apud Antonium, Laodiceæ causam dicit, atque Antonium muneribus placat: quod factum Antonio à bello Parthico & Armenico redeunte. Herodes, domum reversus, omnia invenit intestinis dissi-diis plena, & Alexandrum socrum in vincula conjicit.

head.i: §. 14. Anno P. J. 4680. U. C. 720. M. Antonio II. & L. Scribonio Libone coss. Jul. 12. Herodis 6 / 7 14[?]

main_text.p: Antonius contra Armenios proficiscens, Cleopatram habuit ad Euphratem usque sequacem: unde rediens, quas illi extorserat regiones perspexit, Herodem quoque invisit, cui partem Arabiæ & reditus agri Hierichuntini locavit, ejusdemque concubitu frustra tentato, reducta est ab Herode usque ad terminos Ægypti. Sub anni finem Armenorum Regem, dolo captum, Alexandriæ in triumpho duxit Antigonus. Aretas locata Herodi tributa sponte persolvit.

head.i: §. 15. Anno P. J. 4681. U. C. 721. C. Cæf. Octa-viano 11 & L. Volcatio Tullo coss. Jul. 13. Herodis 7 14 / 5[?]

main_text.p: Arabs adhuc in pendendo Herodi tributo perseve-rat; quod Cleopatra[?] ei locaverat.

head.i: §. 16. Anno P. J. 4682. U. C. 722. Cn. Dom. Ahenobarbo & C. Sosio coss. Julu.[?] 14. Herodis 8 1 / 9 6[?]

main_text.p: Simultates inter Antonium & Octavianum in publicas erumpunt accusationes. Antonius queritur, quod Cæsar proprio suo arbitrio Lepidum magistratu depulerit, provincias & exercitum cum Lepidi tum Sexti sibi vendicarit, dimidiam horum omnium partem postulans, nec non militum, quos Cæsar ex Italiâ, utrique communi delegerat. Cæsar offensus erat, quod Antonius contra fidem conjugalem sororem suam, quam conjugem duxerat, omittens, in Cleopatræ amplexibus hæ-reret.

page.notes: Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page along the right margin are left out. Stacked fractions after "Herodis" in the three headings are doubtful and marked [?]; "Cleopatra" in §. 15 may read "Cleoparra" in print; "Julu." in §. 16 is doubtful. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
